_comment: Least-privilege policy for SkyPilot to run the Cairn spot fleet, applied to the 'cairn-skypilot' IAM user via infra/aws/bootstrap.sh (AWS CLI, never the console). HARDENED (forward-pass H5/H6): region-locked to TWO regions — eu-south-2 (Spain, opt-in: the g6.xlarge gpt-oss proof) + ap-northeast-2 (Seoul, default-enabled: the g7e.2xlarge GLM-5.2 Blackwell headline, ~40% cheaper g7e spot). The lock covers both pools since the gate is region+tag, not instance type; destructive instance actions gated on the 'cairn' resource tag (the launch must tag instances cairn=true); IAM scoped to skypilot-* roles with PassRole pinned to EC2. MUST be validated before relying on it: `aws iam simulate-principal-policy` + a live `sky launch`. If SkyPilot fails an action, loosen THAT action specifically — never revert to Resource:* . Cross-check SkyPilot's current documented AWS policy and consider adding a PermissionsBoundary condition to CreateRole. [test: live policy-sim]
